description: A scheduled playlist that is also a member of a group. Its own schedule is still honored while it plays via the group: inside the window the scheduled member plays, outside it the group force-advances past it to the unscheduled fallback member. Documents that group membership does not bypass the member's schedule, and that the member plays only through its parent group here: the group is unscheduled and therefore always schedule-active, which suppresses the member's standalone play at the top level.
